scope: Read-only inventory requested by coordinator after cold media owner conflict; no production/helper changes by this inventory
method: Search all application Python/shell sources for owner/ownership/marker/.garimpei paths, then read consumers/configuration at boundaries

entries.handling: Preserve validated destination marker; exclude source marker; this is controller metadata, not copied business content.

entries.expected: destination environment_id, exact text without newline
boundaries: absent marker on populated non-environment-named root can raise media_storage_owner_required
entries.handling: Validate source owner; initialize/preserve valid destination metadata before copying user data. Verify actual read and write preparation, not only file hashes.

entries.expected: destination environment_id, exact text without newline
boundaries: ArchiveGateway._prepare verifies owner before new backup/export
missing marker with existing data raises archive_directory_not_owned
entries.handling: Same destination-specific treatment as media; verify actual read/verify and prepare/create of a new archive after adoption/rollback.

entries.expected: blocked until target-specific DB barrier/private reconciliation agree on backup_id/state
entries.handling: Not in private.tar or inference-only state copy. Never import a reconciled source marker as permission to send; verify target build_recovery_guard(), not only RobotControl=false.
Outside cold payload. Do not copy ownership or infer termination from file absence; recovery/stop confirmation already has separate real evidence.

entries.kind: advisory flock inode, no owner identity content
entries.handling: Live flock state does not travel with copied bytes. No environment ownership marker found in the input registry, tokenizer or prepared-PNG store.

entries.marker: admission-reservations.json / input-registry.json / tokenizer.json / hash-named derived files
entries.kind: portable state/artifacts, not environment ownership markers
entries.handling: Preserve request signatures, authorization metadata and artifact bytes. Do not delete quotas or registries under a blanket owner/lock cleanup.

entries.marker: configured browser state .lock and Chromium-managed profile internals
entries.kind: browser/profile lock, no Garimpei per-environment owner marker found
entries.handling: Application uses private_directory and flock; IntegrationSettings stores login state in PostgreSQL. Keep browser stopped during copy; do not rewrite cookies/profile internals as owner metadata.
Retain destination resource labels; verify them before mutation. They are not source payload data to import.

limitations: Third-party WAHA/Chromium private formats were not modified or authenticated; synthetic surface preservation and explicit cold shutdown remain required.
This inventory is not an adoption PASS; actual LocalMediaStore/ArchiveGateway operations are required after the helper fix.
